prompt.high_level_description: Repair the bottom band of an existing pixel art background of a ruined burial grove. Keep the exact palette, light, scale, oblique 2.5D camera and fine controlled dusty hand-painted pixel clusters of the existing image. The flat paved floor ends at the bottom in the edge of a raised stone terrace, and below that edge is the terrace's front face seen straight on: big old dark fieldstone blocks in deep shadow, dry roots and dead brown vines hanging over the edge, like the ledge a side-scroller hero walks on.

compositional_deconstruction.background: The same flat paved floor above, ending in one clean edge.

elements.desc: The terrace's dark front face of big old fieldstone blocks, with roots and dead vines hanging over its top edge.
